column3: src/light/types.ts: changed "export interface LightBase extends SceneNode" to "extends Pick<SceneNode, \"name\">", so lights are no longer typed as transform nodes
src/light/spot-light.ts: off-by-one, the spot writer writes the cone cosine to data[o + 16] instead of data[o + 15], so it writes past its 16-float entry
src/large-world/floating-origin.ts: added light._writeLightUbo(data, o) in the offset loop before reading the type, a second caller of the writers
src/render/mesh-light-layout.ts: replaced ${Math.ceil(MAX_LIGHTS / 4)} with a hard-coded 4 and left the import, so the module still imports the cap but no longer bakes it in
src/render/scene-lights-ubo.ts: computeLightsVersion takes Math.max of light versions instead of summing them
src/light/set-light-diffuse-color.ts: widened the parameter to also accept { diffuseColor: [number, number, number] } and write whichever of diffuseColor/diffuse the light has
src/light/point-light.ts: removed copyBase(light, clone) from the point light's _cloneNode, so it no longer copies shared state through the copier
src/light/point-light.ts: the point writer writes light.position.x/y/z (local) instead of world matrix w[12..14], so it no longer writes raw world space
src/light/area-light-ltc.ts: fetch(LTC_URL) changed to fetch(new URL("./areaLightsLTC.bin", import.meta.url)), a bundled file; the URL constant stays but is unused
src/light/rect-area-light.ts: the shadow-generator check calls console.warn with the same message instead of throw new Error
src/light/clustered.ts: removed the '|| !!container._spotSupport !== !!spotSupport' clause from the refresh check, so spot support appearing late no longer raises the error
src/light/clustered.ts and clustered-spot-support.ts: moved the binding list into one exported _clusteredBindings() in clustered-spot-support.ts that both extensions call, so only one copy is left
